messages:
ara-sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'Aurora Finance' requests EU-only for a POC. Requirements: data-at-rest + in-transit in eu-west-1, control plane must stay in EU, no automatic US failover, BYOK via customer HSM, and full subproc list. Can presales/ops/sec confirm feasibility and cost delta?

ben-presales: We can support with Dedicated or Private. Hosted API can't do customer HSM. Quick clarifying Qs for customer: 1) Strict single-region (eu-west-1) or allowed failover to eu-west-2? 2) Required RTO/RPO? 3) Will they provide CloudHSM or HSM appliance?

chloe-ops: Operational note: tenant pinning + region restriction is doable. We'll need to set fallback_policy: none and kv_cache: local to avoid cross-region KV reads. This will increase cold-start latency. Also need VPC peering or private link from their network.

dave-sec: Security: BYOK with customer-managed HSM forces Private or on-prem deployment. We'll need keywrap design, attestation, and a signed addendum on telemetry. We can keep logs and telemetry in EU but legal must sign subproc attestation. I'll gather SOC2 + subproc export for the customer.

ben-presales: Ballpark pricing: Dedicated EU-only baseline +18% to +28% vs hosted depending on commit. BYOK integration one-time ~$2k-$4k plus monthly key ops ~$700. Exact after qps/token sizing.

ticket-bot: Created INF-9981: "Aurora Finance EU-only POC: BYOK, subproc list, region pin" assigned to ben-presales, chloe-ops, dave-sec.

ara-sales: Thanks. I'll ask Aurora for single-region confirmation, network diagram, and HSM contact. Propose tech call Tue 11:00 CET.

ben-presales: I'll draft Dedicated + BYOK addendum and share before the call.

chloe-ops: I'll prepare peering checklist and minimal ops runbook for tenant pin + kv cache settings.

dave-sec: Uploading SOC2 + subproc list to the ticket, and noting hosted vs private constraints for BYOK.

ara-sales: Great, action items assigned. :thumbsup:
